notes.title: Changes to WAVESHAPER leaderboards
notes.content:
Upcoming update for WAVESHAPER contains difficulty changes intended to prevent the game from becoming too easy after reaching a certain score.

Due to pre-update scores becoming harder to reach, the current leaderboard entries for highscores and streaks in both normal and hard mode will be moved to their own read-only legacy leaderboard after the update has been released.

[list][h1]General changes[/h1][*]Changed the Steam API error message so its more clear what effect it has on the game
    [*]Old high score & streak leaderboards moved to the end of the list
[/list] 
[list][h1]Normal mode[/h1]
    [*]Increased obstacle variance at higher scores
[/list]
 [list][h1]Hard mode[/h1]
    [*]Maximum speed doubled
    [*]Increased obstacle variance at higher scores
    [*]Lowered maximum consecutive obstacles from 5 to 4
[/list] 


[strike]Update is available in the "test" beta branch (Windows only).
[/strike]
Update has been released.
